controlled_scope: Direct native BEGIN/publication/END metadata, no renderer/admission; four cases of ten calls, two discarded warmups.

decision.mechanism: Cache clipped work geometry at AES publication using a general non-wrapping Layers layout epoch, live identity, frame kind, iconified mode and current source bounds.
decision.reason: Publish costs 5.204 ms and clipping 1.924 ms per fragmented Counter tick; work geometry alone costs 0.334 ms. Retain paint/readiness work and END policy.
decision.scene_stamp: Append LONGCARD layoutEpoch to Scene; initialize nonzero, advance before every Rebuild, zero permanently disables reuse on exhaustion. Existing rebuild statistics remain unchanged. Hidden bounds changes are caught by source-bound comparison.
decision.private_state: One LONGCARD geometryEpoch, CARD geometryKind and BYTE geometryIconified per AES Window: eight aligned bytes, six windows = 48 upper-RAM bytes. Epoch zero is invalid. Scene storage grows four upper-RAM bytes. No extra region.
decision.lifecycle: Force invalid on Create/Delete and AESSTATE.Bind. A new Scene lifetime requires binding the fresh service before clients. No live reinitialization. On failed Rebuild the epoch already changes; existing visibility clearing/error behavior remains.
decision.public_abi: Keep AES wire/view/C imports unchanged. Regenerate and version ordinary-call Layers Scene layout; rebuild native programs.
targets: At least 10% lower caller CPU in controlled four_fragmented fixed-layout metadata workload.
At least 5% lower total caller CPU for matched counter_tick_fragmented.
Investigate any changed-layout/control regression above 5%; compare admission and inclusive helper costs.
